mapper.sql: t.status='PENDING' AND r.del_flag='0' AND e.del_flag='0' AND r.status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED','UNSUPPORTED') AND e.verdict IN ('UNKNOWN','UNSUPPORTED') AND e.task_id=t.id AND e.reconciliation_id=r.id AND (r.last_error_code='LEGACY_WALLET_REVIEW_REQUIRED' OR r.create_time <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-#{thresholdSeconds},NOW())) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_execution_permit p WHERE p.task_id=t.id AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND NOT (p.execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE') AND p.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND p.lease_until > NOW(3))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_execution_permit p WHERE p.task_id=t.id AND p.token=t.execution_permit_token AND p.state='RELEASED' AND p.execution_mode IN ('SYNC_TEXT','SYNC_IMAGE')) OR (r.last_error_code='LEGACY_WALLET_REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND e.evidence_type='LOCAL_LEDGER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_execution_permit p WHERE p.task_id=t.id AND p.token=t.execution_permit_token AND p.state='RELEASED' AND p.execution_mode='LEGACY')))
mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM aid_media_task t JOIN aid_media_submission_reconciliation r ON r.task_id=t.id JOIN aid_media_submission_evidence e ON e.id=r.last_evidence_id WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_media_task_anomaly a WHERE a.task_id=t.id) ORDER BY r.create_time,t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO aid_media_task_anomaly (task_id,status,anomaly_type,failure_count,last_error_message,first_detected_time, last_detected_time,next_recheck_time,create_by,create_time) SELECT t.id,'PENDING','SUBMISSION_RESULT_UNKNOWN',1, CASE WHEN r.last_error_code='LEGACY_WALLET_REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN '历史任务状态与原账本不一致，已暂停自动退款；请核对原始结算记录' ELSE '提交结果待核实，尚无可信终态；原任务、冻结费用和执行占用继续保留' END, r.create_time,NOW(),r.next_retry_at,'scheduler',NOW() FROM aid_media_task t JOIN aid_media_submission_reconciliation r ON r.task_id=t.id JOIN aid_media_submission_evidence e ON e.id=r.last_evidence_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId} AND
mapper.select: SELECT a.task_id FROM aid_media_task_anomaly a JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=a.task_id LEFT JOIN aid_media_submission_reconciliation r ON r.task_id=t.id AND r.del_flag='0' WHERE a.anomaly_type='SUBMISSION_RESULT_UNKNOWN' AND a.status IN ('PENDING','WAITING') AND (t.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') OR (r.status='ACCEPTED' AND t.provider_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.provider_task_id<>'' AND a.last_detected_time<=r.update_time)) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: a.id, a.task_id taskId, t.user_id userId, u.user_name userName, COALESCE(b.project_id,t.project_id) projectId, b.object_id nodeId, t.biz_task_type bizType, t.media_type mediaType, t.protocol providerCode, t.model_name modelCode, t.status taskStatus, a.anomaly_type anomalyType, a.status anomalyStatus, a.last_error_message anomalyReason, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.first_detected_time,COALESCE(a.resolved_time,NOW())) waitingSeconds, a.first_detected_time detectedAt, a.last_recheck_time lastCheckedAt, a.next_recheck_time nextReviewTime, a.last_error_message lastCheckMessage, a.wait_reason handlingReason, a.update_by handler, a.resolved_time handledAt, t.billing_status billingStatus, t.frozen_amount frozenAmount, t.actual_cost actualCost, t.billing_trace_id billingTraceId, CASE WHEN a.status='COMPENSATION_PENDING' OR t.billing_status IN ('FROZEN','REFUNDING','SETTLING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END compensationPending, a.update_time updateTime, t.provider_task_id providerTaskId, t.upstream_accept_time upstreamAcceptTime, t.last_progress_time lastProgressTime, t.terminal_time terminalTime, a.last_provider_status lastProviderStatus, a.resolution_type resolutionType
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) pendingCount, COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,first_detected_time,NOW())),0) longestWaitingSeconds, MAX(update_time) updateTime FROM aid_media_task_anomaly WHERE status IN ('PENDING','WAITING','COMPENSATION_PENDING')

SELECT FROM aid_media_task_anomaly a JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=a.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.user_id LEFT JOIN aid_canvas_task_binding b ON b.task_id=t.id WHERE a.status IN ('PENDING','WAITING','COMPENSATION_PENDING') ORDER BY a.last_detected_time DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM aid_media_task_anomaly a JOIN aid_media_task t ON t.id=a.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=t.user_id LEFT JOIN aid_canvas_task_binding b ON b.task_id=t.id WHERE a.id=#{id} LIMIT 1
